title: Thiruthani
desc: Velu, a gym instructor, refuses to help Duraipandi in his fight for social causes. Later, he changes his mind when he meets with an accident and learns that he is going to die soon.

title: Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy
desc: Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy, the ruler of the Rayalaseema region, resists the tyranny of the East India Company and sparks a revolution in the process.

title: Nallavanukku Nallavan
desc: Gangadharan, a kind man, hires Manickam, a reformed criminal, at his factory, who in time wins his trust and is put in charge of the business. However, Gangadharan's spoiled son is unhappy about it.

title: Veerappu
desc: A mathematician wants his son to emulate him and focus on academics. However, the constant pressure forces his son to become a rebel and venture into the world of crime.

title: Pokkiri
desc: Thamizh, an undercover officer posing as a hitman, falls for Shruthi, who disapproves of his violent lifestyle. Their growing bond faces risks from his hidden mission.
